home.title: Mezastar Trade-Fairness Tool
home.tagline: Two people each pick a batch of tags — see whether the trade is fair.

catalog.title: Tag Catalog
catalog.subtitle: Browse all migrated Meza Tags with their transparent score breakdown.
catalog.searchPlaceholder: Name or number (e.g. Pikachu, 皮卡丘, R-1-1)
catalog.noResults: No tags match your search and filters.

auth.signInIntro: Enter your email and we'll send you a one-time sign-in link. No password needed.
auth.linkSent: Check your inbox — we sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on this device to finish signing in.
auth.sendError: We couldn't send the link. Check the email address and try again.

pending.title: Awaiting approval

collection.signInToTrack: Sign in to track your collection

compare.title: Trade Comparator
compare.subtitle: Build each side of a trade and see whether it's fair — with the full reason why.
compare.emptySide: No tags yet — add from your collection or the catalog below.
compare.signInToPull: Sign in to pull tags from your collection.
compare.noOwned: No owned tags yet — mark tags as owned in the catalog to quick-add them here.
compare.noCollection: Nothing in your collection yet — use the catalog to mark tags as owned, wanted, or most-wanted.
compare.searchPlaceholder: Search by name or number (e.g. Pikachu, 皮卡丘, R-1-1)
compare.addBothSides: Add at least one tag to each side to see the verdict.
compare.richerFair: Scores are within the fair range.
compare.topUpMine: Your side could add about NT${amount} to match the market value.
compare.topUpTheirs: Their side could add about NT${amount} to match the market value.
compare.topUpNone: Market values already match — no cash top-up needed.
compare.topUpNote: Based on the market-price gap (sum of medians), separate from the score.
compare.stateAgree: Fair on both collector value and market.
compare.stateReinforceMine: Your side is ahead on both collector value and market.
compare.stateReinforceTheirs: Their side is ahead on both collector value and market.
compare.divergeScoreEvenMarketMine: Even on collector value — but your side is worth about NT${amount} more at market.
compare.divergeScoreEvenMarketTheirs: Even on collector value — but their side is worth about NT${amount} more at market.
compare.divergeMarketEvenScoreMine: Your side is ahead on collector value, but the market values are about even.
compare.divergeMarketEvenScoreTheirs: Their side is ahead on collector value, but the market values are about even.
compare.divergeOppositeScoreMine: Your side scores higher on collector value, but their side is worth about NT${amount} more at market.
compare.divergeOppositeScoreTheirs: Their side scores higher on collector value, but your side is worth about NT${amount} more at market.
compare.marketGapMine: Your side is worth about NT${amount} more.
compare.marketGapTheirs: Their side is worth about NT${amount} more.
compare.marketUnverifiedNote: ≈ This cash figure leans on unverified prices — treat it as a rough guide.
